name: Renita Armstrong
office: Bellflower Unified School District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 2

items.text: Renita Armstrong represents Trustee Area 2 on the Bellflower Unified School District board. She was president in 2022. Her campaign says she is a Montebello Unified School District special education specialist with 27 years of experience. Her campaign also cites 15 years of PTA membership.

sentences.text: Renita Armstrong represents Trustee Area 2 on the Bellflower Unified School District board.
Her campaign says she is a Montebello Unified School District special education specialist with 27 years of experience.
Her campaign also cites 15 years of PTA membership.

items.text: A 2022 state audit found the administration and board failed at financial oversight, keeping an $83 million reserve while inconsistently providing services to students with disabilities. In 2020, the Los Angeles County Office of Education sued the district for refusing to comply with the revocation of its fiscal independence; lawyers denied wrongdoing. As board president, she oversaw hiring Superintendent Ben Drati, who left in 2024 under a mutual separation agreement.
